title: Credit-Card Reservation Deposits as Down Payment Credit on Kestrel Auto Finance Orders under Vehicle Purchase Agreements
content:
**Rule.** On an order under Vehicle Purchase Agreements financed through Kestrel Auto Finance, a reservation deposit taken by credit card is borrowed money, and the applied deposit counts as a down payment credit according to the tier of the order's approved contract in Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts.

| Tier of the approved contract | Any reservation deposit on the order paid by credit card | Applied deposit counted as a down payment credit |
|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Finance Tier C, Tier D or Tier E | yes | none of it |
| Kestrel Finance Tier B | yes | half of it, rounded half up to the cent |
| Kestrel Finance Tier C, Tier D, Tier E or Tier B | no | all of it |
| Kestrel Finance Tier A or Tier A+ | either | all of it |

*Applied deposit*: the reservation deposit money applied to the order. *Paid by credit card*: a reservation deposit received on the order on the credit-card channel; a deposit paid by debit card or ACH is not paid by credit card.

**Hypothetical cases.**
- Tier B, a $750.00 deposit paid by credit card and applied at signing: $375.00 counts.
- Tier B, a $1000.00 deposit paid by debit card: $1000.00 counts.
- Tier D, a $500.00 deposit paid by credit card: nothing counts.
- Tier A, a $500.00 deposit paid by credit card: $500.00 counts.
